acceptanceCriteria: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test and npm run build were each run by QA with exit codes explicitly captured (build in a copy of the tree), output tails recorded (635 tests or more; / route First Load JS within 2 kB of 125 kB), the uncommitted diff against 9847be9 touches only files named in report 35, and the components/avatar/TalkingAvatar.tsx change is limited to the no-WebGL guard (design section 9 permits hero changes only in that file).

Inert page and failures verified in QA's own browser runs on the production build: while playing, Tab never leaves the game overlay and the page behind it is absent from the accessibility tree; after Exit, Cancel, a forced asset download failure, WebGL unavailable and a forced context loss, the portfolio is usable with focus on Play (or, without WebGL, the page renders with no Play button and no blank screen); an invalid save starts at 0/3 with no visible error.

Performance claims spot-checked by QA on the production build with host load recorded: rAF p95 under 17.5 ms walking the campus at 1440x900; Play to playable on a cold click is not slower than the report's figure by more than 20 percent; the hero stays free of freezes over 50 ms while idle after a Play hover; no main-thread work or game assets are fetched on ordinary portfolio browsing; heap and listener counts do not grow monotonically over 5 Play and Exit cycles. QA judges whether the partial cold-load gain (about 600 ms of the targeted 1.1 s) is acceptable and records it as a finding or a known limitation.

M4 findings verified fixed: .vitest/ is git-ignored; approaching the beacon before three cells shows the non-interactive hint on desktop and in labelled touch emulation and E or Interact does nothing; at 390x844 the guidance chip and Exit button are at least 8 px apart from DOM rects. Reduced motion yields the short crossfade and a fade-only celebration. An axe-core scan of the HUD, pause menu and completion panel reports 0 serious or critical violations.

Short regression: the full challenge loop completes with the keyboard at 1440x900, the tower passage camera sweep has 0 frames inside geometry or with the avatar hidden, Exit restores the exact hero layout with focus on Play, and touch walking plus Interact still works at 390x844 in emulation. New content has no em dash or machine-local path, and QA states approve or reject with every finding given a severity and an owner.
